messages:
Monica: FYI I'm planning to merge runtime change that tweaks KV prefetch heuristics. Targeting tonight's change window (23:00 UTC). Need quick sync with console + router before merge. Any blockers?
Sam: quick question — does this change affect TTL-based eviction?
Monica: no TTL semantics changed, just prefetch threshold and async fill. Should reduce cold token latency.
Lee: console needs a small feature-flag toggle to disable the UI metric that assumes old prefetch behavior. I can ship the flag but need the runtime merge to be coordinated.
Anya: router: header-fingerprints might change slightly for very short seqs. We saw a 0.3% mismatch in staging. Can we pin a compatibility route for 6 hours after deploy?
Nina: SRE + obs here. We need a clear rollback cue: if p95 token latency > 2x baseline for more than 10m OR error-rate spike > 0.5% we rollback. Also want a canary wave (5%) then 25% then 100%.
DevOps: agreed. I'll create the deploy waves in the bot. Also request that console opens the flag for the 25% wave so we can test UI truthfulness.
Monica: updated release notes and quick test plan here: https://internal.redwood/release/2026/runtime-prefetch-v2 — add your thumbs by 21:30 UTC if ok. :eyes:
Lee: adding the UI flag: `console.featureFlags.set('prefetch_v2_ui', 'experimental')` — will be queued in the same change window.
Anya: router pin: create route override `X-RW-Compat: prefetch-v1` for 6h fallback. If no regressions, we remove after the 6h maintenance window.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks started for release rev-2026-03-21-prefetch-v2. Checks: unit-tests ✅, canary-smoke ✅, infra-quotas ✅.
deploy-bot: Scheduling waves: wave-1=5% @1719904200, wave-2=25% @1719905400, wave-3=100% @1719909000.
Sam: I ran a stress run on staging and added a small tweak to kv_sync backoff. Pushing patch now. Will confirm by 21:00 UTC.
Monica: if Sam's tweak lands, we should re-run canary-smoke. DevOps — hold final merge until Sam confirms.
DevOps: holding merge. I'll post the gate when all checks green.
Nina: monitoring dashboard panels I want up during the window: token p50/p95/p99, request error-rate, router header-mismatch rate, console UI metric diffs. Will pin on the ops dashboard.
Lee: I'll keep the UI flag gated behind the 25% wave and verify the metric delta before enabling at 100%.
Anya: reminder: router team will keep fallback route in place for 6h and will auto-remove with a script unless we flag manual hold.
Monica: plan sounds good. No objections by 21:30 UTC -> I will give merge go. Please react with :thumbsup: if you approve.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Lee: :thumbsup:
Anya: :thumbsup:
Nina: :thumbsup:
DevOps: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Gate: HOLD until 1719910200 or explicit UNHOLD.
Monica: acknowledged, will wait for final smoke.
Sam: final smoke passed at 21:05 UTC.
DevOps: UNHOLDING deploy-bot. Starting wave-1 now. Good luck everyone :shipit:
deploy-bot: wave-1 in progress (5%). Canary metrics stable after 12m.
Nina: monitoring green so far. Temporary small spike in small-seq latency but within baseline noise.
Anya: router fallback unused. No header mismatches observed.
Lee: console flag still off. I'll flip at wave-2.
DevOps: advancing to wave-2 (25%).
deploy-bot: wave-2 complete. No rollback triggers hit.
Lee: enabling UI flag for 25% now. Verifying metrics.
Lee: UI metric diff within 0.6% — acceptable.
Monica: proceeding to wave-3. If anyone wants to hold, now's the time.
Nina: all green from SRE. No holds.
DevOps: wave-3 scheduled and running.
deploy-bot: wave-3 complete. Release rev-2026-03-21-prefetch-v2 marked SUCCESS.
Monica: great work team. Router will remove the compat override at 05:00 UTC unless we flag hold.
Anya: override will auto-cleanup. I'll post if we need manual retention.
Lee: will revert UI flag if we see delayed metric drift.
Sam: will watch staging for any late surprises.
Monica: closing thread. I'll add final notes to the release doc and tag this release in the changelog. Thanks :tada:
